# Packages used should be installed before loading
library("tidyverse")
library(readr)
library("tibble")
#some packages might need to be removed bc it is mentioned already

#load the data
Data_For_Matrix <- read_csv("../data/data_set1.csv",
                      show_col_types = FALSE)
                      
#write_csv(Data_set_1_clean, file = "../data/Data_set_1_clean.csv")
#Data_Set1 <- read_csv("../data/data_set_1_clean.csv", show_col_types = F)

#Selection of columns for matrix
heatmap_data <- Data_For_Matrix |>
  select(
  Gene_ID,
    `FC_AC(P/G)`,
    `FC_TF18(P/G)`,
    `FC_rin(P/G)`,
    `FC_TF18_P/AC_P`,
    `FC_rin_P/AC_P`,
    `FC_TF18_G/AC_G`,
    `FC_rin_G/AC_G`
    )
    
# heatmap 
heatmap_matrix <- heatmap_data |>
  tibble::column_to_rownames("Gene_ID") |>
  as.matrix()
